title: BEAST CIVILIZATION v1.0.0: Bare-Metal Polyglot Multi-Colony AI Architecture, Cross-Architecture KV-Cache Transfer, Blackwell PTX Kernels, and 81 Six-Kernel Pure Lean 4.35.0 Proofs
description: Zero-dependency bare-metal polyglot multi-colony AI engine in Zig 0.17.1, Rust 1.94.1 (8 crates), CRuby 3.4.9/Prism/YARV, C11, NVIDIA Blackwell sm_12.0 CUDA PTX, and 81 six-kernel Pure Lean 4.35.0 formal proofs (Palomar Challenge/Solution + NonVacuity + AdversarialTests), with pre-registered N=24 Holm-Bonferroni statistical evaluation and clean-room Python exact-arithmetic oracle.
